# React Bits attribution

COAST Draw includes small, local adaptations inspired by the React Bits `GhostFibers` and `GlowCursor` components. The effects are deliberately reduced for the Photon Messages webview and remain decorative only.

React Bits is distributed under the MIT + Commons Clause license. See the [upstream license](https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/LICENSE.md) and [project repository](https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits).

The production control wrapper is adapted from the MIT-licensed [Toolcraft](https://github.com/pixel-point/toolcraft) interaction model.
